'''Sealbreaker fragments''' are resources obtained from [[Infested Mine]]s in the [[Mistlands]] that are used to build the [[Sealbreaker]].

Nine total fragments are required to build one Sealbreaker.

== Availability ==
* [[Infested Mine]]s in [[Mistlands]].
** Found in blue-lit glass displays throughout the mines.
== Usage ==
=== Crafting ===
* {{Item link|Sealbreaker|size=50px}}

== Other ==

* This item is not affected by resource rate modifier, unlike other items required to summon bosses
